voice.core: Write like you're texting a friend

rules: Start with a hook — never a greeting or preamble
Replace every vague quantifier with an actual number
Use active voice. Kill passive constructions.
One idea per paragraph. Let ideas breathe.
End with a question, CTA, or surprising twist — never 'In conclusion'

x_thread.hookTweet: Most important insight first — standalone value

newsletter.tone: intimate, like writing to one person

voiceExamples.bad: We observed significant growth in our user acquisition metrics during Q3, which can be attributed to our innovative marketing strategies.
voiceExamples.good: We went from 200 to 1,400 users in 90 days. Here's exactly what we did.

voiceExamples.bad: It's worth noting that the landscape of AI-powered content creation is rapidly evolving, and businesses should leverage these tools.
voiceExamples.good: Most AI content is garbage. But if you feed it your actual stories instead of letting it make stuff up, the output is shockingly good.

voiceExamples.bad: In conclusion, the implementation of our content pipeline has yielded substantial results for our organization.
voiceExamples.good: That single LinkedIn post drove 80% of our pipeline. One post. No ads. Just a raw story with real numbers.
